games.title: CRASH
games.pitch: dodge the tasks, drink the coffee, don't get cooked.

games.title: Handbag Havoc
games.pitch: granny on a mobility scooter bowls garden gnomes into each other with her purse. it's self-defence.
games.controls: wasd / arrows or drag anywhere to steer. turn hard to power up the purse. 1 2 3 picks upgrades. r restart, p pause, m mute.

games.title: only 1% can close this pop-up
games.pitch: 30 fake pop-ups, 5 seconds each. the x runs away. so will your confidence.
games.controls: tap / click to close, drag where it says drag. enter or space starts and retries, m mutes.

games.title: +1 Speed Keyboard Escape
games.pitch: every key is +1 speed. esc is further than you think.
games.controls: tap, click or space to jump (hold for a longer jump). crash runs by himself. land dead centre for perfect bonuses. p pause, r back to boot (keeps speed), m mute.

games.title: desktop jam
games.pitch: tap your desktop icons until they leave. final_FINAL_v3.docx is in the way. it always is.
games.controls: tap or click an icon to slide it off in its arrow's direction. keyboard: arrows move the cursor, enter/space taps, r restarts, p pauses, m mutes.

games.title: fathom
games.pitch: submarine duel against a computer with opinions. every miss tells you how close you were. decoys lie.
games.controls: tap or click the enemy sea to fire. arrow keys + enter also fire, s toggles sonar. drag subs to move, tap to rotate. modes: classic or salvo.

games.title: tab hoarder
games.pitch: stack browser tabs on a tired computer. perfect drops stack a multiplier. free_ram_download.exe is a trap.
games.controls: tap / click / space to drop. m mutes, p pauses, s shares on the result card.

games.title: crash test (daily)
games.pitch: a new sliding puzzle every day, the same for everyone. get the hot air out of crash in as few moves as possible, then flex your 🟩🟨🟥 grid.
games.controls: drag parts · tab + arrows · u undo · r restart

games.title: bellchain
games.pitch: an idle game that plays actual music. buy a cowbell. then 200 more.
games.controls: tap or click anywhere to ring (space works too). buy bells and upgrades in the panel. m mutes.

games.title: level devil.exe
games.pitch: a troll platformer where the floor, the exit, the cursor and the taskbar all want you dead. 31 levels, a blue screen every death, infinite retries.
games.controls: ←→ / a d move · ↑ / w / space jump · r restart · esc levels · touch buttons on mobile

games.title: pixel purge
games.pitch: crash's pictures got corrupted. load floppy-disk turrets onto a 5-slot bench and shoot every pixel back into place. fill the bench and you're cooked.
games.controls: tap / click a floppy (keys 1-3), z = ctrl+z, r = restart. badges show how many pixels each front disk can hit.

games.title: crash cheats at tic tac toe
games.pitch: beat crash at tic tac toe. he deletes your x's, fakes lag, spills coffee and blue-screens when he's losing. good luck.
games.controls: tap / click a square · keys 1–9 or arrows + space · q firewall, w ctrl+z, e report (costs a token)

games.title: overdue notice
games.pitch: smash popups and piggy banks for cash, pay rent and wi-fi before the late fees stack up, and keep the debt collector out. an incremental about being broke.
games.controls: tap / click popups and bills · space smashes (fast taps build a combo) · p pays all · g takes a gig · 1–4 tabs · 1/2 pick the daily situation

games.title: +1 ram every second
games.pitch: you gain +1 mb every second. eat smaller processes. run from bigger ones. become the kernel.
games.controls: drag anywhere to steer (mouse or wasd/arrows on desktop). p pauses, m mutes.
